cards.name: hero
cards.title: Unarchiving a post? **Remove the tag first**
cards.sub: Unarchived posts return to their old spot quietly. Tags are the one thing Instagram doesn’t document.

right.label: Unarchive
items: Back in its original grid spot

steps.title: Three-dot menu
steps.text: Top of the post, or bottom right on Reels.

steps.title: Tap Archive
steps.text: It disappears from view right away.

steps.title: Remove the tag
steps.text: Edit the post before it goes back.

steps.title: Show on profile
steps.text: It returns by its original date.

steps.title: Re-tag later?
steps.text: Adding a tag usually notifies them.

right.label: Stories archive
items: Saved after 24 hours, if it’s on

cards.name: bottom-line
cards.quote: Archive instead of delete, and **remove the tag before you unarchive.**
cards.by: Unarchived posts return by their original date, not as new posts.
